question: Which economically distinct signal-time stock descriptors separate completed CHINEXT V1 trades consistently enough to justify one executable replay?
honesty_boundary: The seven descriptors and their coarse economic cutoffs were declared before trade outcomes were joined. The resulting 2018-2023 comparisons are consumed exploration, not confirmation or untouched OOS.
boundary_incident: A recursive inventory and an indiscriminate read exposed post-2023 phase-summary metadata elsewhere in the repository. No post-2023 row or exposed outcome is an input to this experiment; future confirmation must use a separately quarantined data block.
episode_check: Half-calendar-year high-versus-nonhigh mean-return gaps for relative-strength acceleration; report all supported episodes without optimizing the boundary.
exit_diagnostic: Exit reason and coarse realized holding-duration summaries are attribution only. They are not signal-time predictors and cannot promote an exit rule.
promotion_rule: At most one descriptor advances: same adverse/favorable direction in both coarse blocks and at least 8 adverse supported half-year episodes, with an interpretable non-tail subgroup and no threshold search.
prohibited: future path fields as entry predictors
threshold or subgroup search after outcome inspection
promoting the descriptive exit attribution into a rule
